      severity: error
      description: lease_date is required for Lease Agreement extraction.
      rule:

        rules:
          - op: present
            field: lease_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: lease_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: lease_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(lease_date)) > 0

            right:

      sourceExpression: base_rent_amount IS NULL OR base_rent_amount >= 0
